Quinn.build: Build armor first. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so there's no reason to build magic resistance specifically for this matchup.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun her and flip her behind you. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks to chip away at her health. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, recast to pull her in once she's below the execute threshold.
Quinn.escape: The window to engage is right after Quinn E Vault is down. Before then, don't use Urgot E Disdain first; chase after Quinn backs away with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot E Disdain.
Quinn.fight: Right after Quinn E Vault is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on her, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Quinn gradually to use your leg cannons that haven't fired yet.
Quinn.laning: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, back off briefly, and farm or trade when the mark is gone. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don't automatically attack minions. If you lose track of Quinn, ward side lanes and jungle paths and warn your allies about her roams early.
Quinn.phase: Secure your advantage with lane pressure and towers in the midgame. In the late game, avoid forcing engages because of your short range.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn comes in from the side, catch her with Urgot E Disdain's stun. Attack the target you pull with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge to set up an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If there's no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute.
Quinn.watch: When marked by Quinn P Harrier, move out of her basic attack range before she can hit you with an empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind a line of minions so it hits them first, and don't force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.

Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start reducing his actual health. Don't engage right after being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. Once Malphite E Ground Slam is down, activate Urgot W Purge and fight at close range. Move around him so your leg cannons that haven't triggered yet aim at him.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him, activate Urgot W Purge, and weave in basic attacks. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, use Q, W, and basic attacks to lower his health below the execute threshold, then recast R. To flip him toward your allies, use Urgot E Disdain with your allies behind you.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so don't start a trade right after being hit. Engage and fight after Malphite E Ground Slam is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be interrupted by crowd control, so when you can't see where he is, don't group with your allies near walls or bushes.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force. Against Malphite's high armor, make use of the max-health-based damage from Urgot P Echoing Flames, and consider penetration to supplement your physical damage.
Malphite.escape: If Malphite E Ground Slam is also down, it's a good time to get close and keep firing. If you're ganked, use Urgot E Disdain's shield and stun to escape.
Malphite.laning: To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don't push the wave unintentionally.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out with your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn't knock several of you up, then counterattack as soon as R is down. If Urgot E Disdain can pull a target from behind the frontline, attack with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there's no angle to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and watch the execute target's position for an AoE fear opportunity.

Aatrox.teamfight: If you can pull out a target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If the target is in the middle of the enemy team when executed, you can fear nearby enemies too. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, don’t force an engage; attack the frontline and wait for an execute opportunity.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, focus on collecting CS without giving Aatrox a kill. Urgot W Purge also attacks minions and can push the lane, so turn it off and last-hit only when you want to pull the wave toward you. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to help you engage instead of using it to poke.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against Aatrox’s main damage. Aatrox also tends to have high armor, so consider penetration when increasing your damage. If his healing can turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling after completing your first core item.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and fling him. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you move around Aatrox to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, keep dealing damage to bring him below the execute threshold, then recast it to pull him in.
Aatrox.escape: The moment after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is used is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, first get out of its area, and save Urgot E Disdain so you can use it then.
Aatrox.fight: Look to trade just after Aatrox uses the empowered attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. When fighting up close, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks while moving around Aatrox to trigger Urgot P Echoing Flames from your other legs. Don’t fight him head-on at equal health while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous if its blade tip hits, so watch the cast and dodge outside its outer edge or inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing is stronger, so stop dueling and create distance.

Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Check for Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution too, and close the gap with Urgot E Disdain especially before her ultimate comes back up. Hit her with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death then to follow with a slow and execute.
Akali.build: The source does not specify a first purchase. Build magic resistance against Akali’s main damage, and get health to help against the missing-health damage from Akali R Perfect Execution. Prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Akali.combo: When Akali’s mobility ability is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and fling her behind you. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to deal leg cannon damage. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, damage her until she is below the execute threshold, then recast it to pull her in and execute her.
Akali.fight: Don’t engage first with Urgot E Disdain while Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are available. After Akali comes out of the smoke to attack you or uses a mobility ability, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. Once you’re on her, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Akali to keep firing with your ready leg cannons.
Akali.laning: When you want to pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and only last-hit so you don’t push the wave by accident.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, press the lane and take turrets to secure your lead. In the late game, avoid forcing teamfight engages because of your short range.
Akali.teamfight: Don’t rush to use Urgot E Disdain to engage while Akali can still escape with a mobility ability. If an opening appears to pull out a target behind the enemy frontline, fling them with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute position that can fear multiple enemies.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once it marks you, her second dash will follow even if you try to escape. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so save Urgot E Disdain to use as she engages.

Camille.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights, and Camille’s side-lane turret pressure is also a threat, so don’t leave the side lane unattended.
Camille.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, Camille W Tactical Sweep, and Camille E Hookshot. However, armor can’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep can turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling after completing your first core item.
Camille.combo: After Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum are down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and fling her behind you. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Camille to trigger Urgot P Echoing Flames. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower her health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast Urgot R.
Camille.escape: If only Camille E Hookshot is down, she can still escape with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, so don’t rush in with Urgot E Disdain. Close the gap with Urgot E Disdain when both mobility abilities are down, especially before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back up, and hit her with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If Camille engages first with E, look for a chance to interrupt her leap with Urgot E Disdain as soon as her hook catches a wall.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield. Once the shield has been removed, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and fight up close. Look for a chance to interrupt Camille E Hookshot’s leap with Urgot E Disdain as soon as her hook catches a wall.
Camille.laning: Stay away from walls and among minions to reduce Camille E Hookshot’s engage angles. Take lane control and pressure her farming before Camille completes her first core item. When you want to pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and only last-hit so you don’t push the wave by accident.
Camille.teamfight: Watch for Camille E Hookshot’s hook to catch a wall so you can interrupt her engage with Urgot E Disdain. If you can pull out a target behind the frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and check the target’s position so the fear from Urgot R’s execute can reach nearby enemies.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a long distance and stun you, so position yourself away from walls. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages, don’t waste Urgot E Disdain. If you’re trapped, wait out the zone’s duration before fighting back.

Kayle.build: Finish your first core item before fitting in Executioner's Calling if the healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing could turn a duel around. Keep applying damage with Urgot W Purge to maintain Grievous Wounds. Build magic resistance against Kayle’s damage, but you need to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast to get the full benefit of that resistance.
Kayle.combo: Slow Kayle with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip her behind you. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Kayle to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower Kayle’s health below the execute threshold before recasting to execute her, but don’t pour on damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment makes her immune to damage.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and engage during a window when Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed boost is down. Use the slow from Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to keep her in range, then close in with Urgot E Disdain. If you’re ganked, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to escape.
Kayle.fight: Start trading aggressively once you’ve put some levels into Urgot W Purge. When you get on Kayle, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you move around her to hit leg cannons that haven’t fired yet. If Kayle steps out of Urgot W Purge’s short range, turn it off instead of chasing with it active.
Kayle.teamfight: Kayle attacks from the backline, so look for a path to reach her from the flank or outside vision, and time your engage with your allies’ crowd control. If there’s no angle to pull Kayle out, don’t force your way in; attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces Urgot’s armor and magic resistance and slows him, so dodge the direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals more damage based on your missing health, so be careful when trading at low health. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t pour on damage; use the stun from Urgot E Disdain to wait out the invulnerability.

Kled.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, W Violent Tendencies, and E Jousting. It can also help to reduce his attack speed, giving you time to avoid the fourth hit from Kled W Violent Tendencies. Kled W Violent Tendencies and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Kled.combo: When Kled’s mobility is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun and flip him behind you with Urgot E Disdain. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks, and triggering your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to bring Kled below the execute threshold, then recast to pull him in.
Kled.escape: If only Kled E Jousting is down, he can escape with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, so don’t rush your engage. When both mobility abilities are down, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain and use the slow from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to stop his escape. If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, save Urgot E Disdain to escape before it pulls you in.
Kled.fight: Engage with Urgot E Disdain after both Kled E Jousting and R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down. Once you’re on him, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Kled to hit leg cannons that haven’t fired yet. While Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, don’t stay on him long enough to take the fourth hit.
Kled.laning: When you’re pulling the lane, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn’t automatically hit minions. If Kled is dismounted, watch his courage meter. If you can’t finish him off, create distance while pressuring him to deny him minion kills and remounting.
Kled.phase: Kled gets weaker after the laning phase and mid game, but Urgot also struggles to engage in teamfights late because of his short range, so take turret advantages during mid game.
Kled.teamfight: Get vision on the flanks to prepare for Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!’s long-range engage. If he engages, keep your formation so the champion in front takes the first charge. Engage as Urgot when you can use Urgot E Disdain to pull out a target behind the enemy frontline, then deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge. If there’s no angle to pull someone out, attack the frontline and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance before it pulls you in, and use Urgot E Disdain to escape if needed. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off so you don’t take the fourth hit, then re-engage. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engages from long range, so use flank vision to spot his approach early.

Aurora.build: Complete your first core item first. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration heals enough to turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance against Aurora’s main damage, and consider movement speed to get out of her telegraphed area. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora’s mobility ability is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun her, then activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks. To set up an execute, hit her with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to slow her, lower her health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. While Aurora is stealthed with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait until she reappears before using your abilities.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds too. In particular, while Aurora R Between Worlds is still on cooldown and her other mobility ability is also down, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain and hit Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If you’re ganked, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to escape.
Aurora.fight: Don’t engage first with Urgot E Disdain while Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds are available. Once her mobility abilities are down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain to stun her. Keep Urgot W Purge active, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Aurora to trigger your leg cannons.
Aurora.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to start your engage. If you want to pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and only last-hit so you don’t push the wave by accident.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights, so choose your engage carefully.
Aurora.teamfight: If you can pull out a target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Check the target’s position so the fear on execution reaches multiple enemies. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and wait for a chance to finish someone. When backing away, don’t leave a low-health ally behind, so Aurora can’t get a takedown and use her leap again.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the line between you and Aurora before the curse returns. The return hit deals more damage the lower your health is, so back away if your health is in a risky range. After Aurora R Between Worlds is cast, leaving the zone can expose you to its slow, so either get out before it forms or look for an opening to fight inside it.

Chogath.build: Complete your first core item first. If Cho'Gath P Carnivore heals enough to turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling. Build magic resistance against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Cho'Gath R Feast deals true damage and E deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking armor or health alone.
Chogath.combo: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and trigger Urgot P Echoing Flames from multiple directions. After hitting him with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast it to finish him.
Chogath.escape: The opportunity to engage comes right after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave or after you dodge its warning. Once you avoid the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, approach with Urgot E Disdain and fight up close against Cho'Gath, who has no mobility ability.
Chogath.fight: Dodge the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture and move out of the frontal area of W Feral Scream, then slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Cho'Gath to hit with P Echoing Flames from legs that haven’t fired yet.
Chogath.laning: Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so stand away from the line of his basic attacks and look for an engage or gank opportunity right after he uses Q Rupture on the wave. Turning on W also pushes the wave, so turn it off and only last-hit when you want to pull the lane toward you.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath gets stronger as he gains stacks, so the matchup becomes harder as the game goes on. Don’t let Cho'Gath R Feast kill you when your health is in a risky range.
Chogath.teamfight: If you can pull out a target behind Cho'Gath’s frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Pulling in the execution target from near the enemy group can fear nearby enemies. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, don’t force an engage; attack the frontline with Urgot W and look for an Urgot R finishing opportunity.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears under your feet, dodge to the side and save Urgot E Disdain for this moment. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream hits you with its frontal silence, you can’t escape with E, so circle around and fight. If you’re at half health or below, move out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius P Hemorrhage, Darius Q Decimate, and Darius W Crippling Strike. Account for the penetration on Darius E Apprehend and the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine, and add some penetration because Darius’s high armor can block Urgot’s physical damage. If the healing from Darius Q Decimate can turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling after completing one core item.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and fling him. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Darius to trigger your leg cannons. To finish, hit him with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast it to pull him in.
Darius.escape: The window after Darius E Apprehend is used is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Darius E Apprehend is still available, save Urgot E Disdain and Flash to respond to it.
Darius.fight: Start trading when Darius E Apprehend misses or cannot be used again. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and move slightly around Darius to hit with leg cannons that haven’t fired yet. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks start building, end the trade, create distance, and look for another opening later.
Darius.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up Urgot E Disdain, and look for a chance to poke right after Darius Q Decimate is used to clear minions. When you want to pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and only last-hit to keep the wave from pushing by accident.
Darius.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights, so choose your engage carefully.
Darius.teamfight: If you can pull out one target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Choose your target based on their position so Urgot R Fear Beyond Death can fear multiple enemies.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with basic attacks, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside his range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or get close to reduce its healing. Create distance while Darius P Hemorrhage stacks are building, and if your health has decreased while you still have stacks, move out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper. If his healing can turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling after completing your first core item to keep Grievous Wounds active with shots from Urgot W Purge.
DrMundo.combo: First slow Mundo with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it will ignore the stun from Urgot E Disdain, so confirm that his passive is down before following up with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks. After hitting him with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast it to execute him.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, follow the slow from Urgot Q Corrosive Charge with an engage using Urgot E Disdain. It’s easier to fight up close if you dodge the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. If you’re ganked, turn off Urgot W Purge and use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and dash to escape.
DrMundo.fight: Approach while blocking Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions, then keep firing with Urgot W Purge active and weave in basic attacks. Move gradually around Mundo to hit with leg cannons from Urgot P Echoing Flames that haven’t fired yet. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, look for another advantage instead of spending more time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.laning: Urgot W Purge also hits nearby minions, so turn it off and only last-hit when you want to pull the lane toward you. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to help you engage instead of using it to poke. Step on the canister dropped by Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases while backing away to stop his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights, so secure the lead you built in the mid game.
DrMundo.teamfight: Instead of chasing Dr. Mundo for a long time while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, look for an opening to pull out an enemy with Urgot E Disdain. Deal damage to the target with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and check the position so the fear reaches nearby enemies when you execute.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target it collides with and deals more damage when your current health is higher, so dodge it from behind minions. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t engage relying on Urgot E Disdain’s stun while his passive is available. Dr. Mundo heals and gets faster when he activates Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage, so don’t spend too long trying to kill him.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, and R deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If her healing can turn a duel around, slot Executioner's Calling after completing your first core item.
Fiora.combo: When Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are both down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then engage with Urgot E Disdain to stun and fling her. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower her health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast it to execute her.
Fiora.escape: The moment after Fiora Q Lunge is used is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. If Fiora W Riposte is also down, you can follow up with the Urgot E Disdain stun and Urgot R Fear Beyond Death without worrying about them being blocked.
Fiora.fight: Bait out Fiora Q Lunge, then slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Fiora W Riposte is available, don’t use Urgot E Disdain or Urgot R Fear Beyond Death carelessly; when you do use them, move to the side to avoid Riposte’s hitbox. When fighting up close, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle around Fiora to aim leg cannons that haven’t fired yet.
Fiora.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up Urgot E Disdain. Turning on Urgot W Purge hits minions too and pushes the lane, so turn it off and only last-hit when you want to pull the lane toward you.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. If there’s an opening to pull out a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and look for a position where Urgot R Fear Beyond Death’s execute can fear nearby enemies.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks Urgot E Disdain and Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, and if it blocks an immobilizing effect, it also stuns you. When Fiora moves in toward a vital, stand on the opposite side of it to narrow her angle. If Fiora uses Fiora R Grand Challenge, stay against a wall to block one side of the vitals.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early in lane to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and E Powder Keg damage. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and R Cannon Barrage deal true damage, which resistances can’t reduce, so build health too. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after your first core item.
Gangplank.combo: When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and a nearby keg has just been placed, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with E Disdain to stun and flip him. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you circle him to hit with your legs. After landing Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, keep damaging him until he’s below the execute threshold, then recast to finish him.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so when his E Powder Keg has just been placed and isn’t primed yet, look for a chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is also down, you can chain Urgot E Disdain’s stun into R Fear Beyond Death. Don’t engage if there’s a primed keg nearby.
Gangplank.fight: When Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and isn’t primed yet, close in and trade. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Gangplank to hit him with legs that haven’t fired yet. Delay the fight if there’s a primed keg nearby.
Gangplank.laning: If Gangplank Q Parrrley poke keeps chipping away at your health, build armor early. When you want to pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don’t push it by accident.
Gangplank.phase: In the mid game, consolidate your gains through pressure and turrets. In the late game, avoid forcing teamfight engages because of your short range.
Gangplank.teamfight: Watch Gangplank E Powder Keg’s explosion radius and the slow from Gangplank R Cannon Barrage as you engage. If you can pull out a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before looking for an execute with R Fear Beyond Death. If the enemy team is grouped and there’s no angle to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline. When executing, consider where nearby enemies will be so they’re hit by the fear.
Gangplank.watch: If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, move out of its explosion radius, and don’t stand where two kegs overlap. If you destroy a keg directly from outside its radius, it won’t explode. Gangplank W Remove Scurvy cleanses crowd control and heals, so don’t count on a guaranteed kill with Urgot E Disdain and R Fear Beyond Death before he uses it.

Garen.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and E Judgment. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so consider your total health instead of relying on resistances alone. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance can turn a duel around, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after your first core item.
Garen.combo: After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage’s brief shield and tenacity window ends, land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to slow him. Once he’s below the execute threshold, recast Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to reel him in and execute.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so when engaging, wait for his Garen Q Decisive Strike silence and Garen W Courage tenacity rather than a mobility ability. After Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used and Garen W Courage’s brief tenacity window ends, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and engage with Urgot E Disdain.
Garen.fight: Start trading after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is used and Garen E Judgment stops spinning. Don’t stay in close combat for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning; once it ends, keep firing with Urgot W Purge.
Garen.laning: Pressure the lane early to limit the time Garen has to build stacks on W Courage.
Garen.phase: Garen grows stronger over time through stacks on Garen W Courage, while Urgot has trouble engaging in late-game teamfights because of his short range, so early and mid-game advantages are important.
Garen.teamfight: A target reeled in by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death is executed in front of Urgot, fearing nearby enemies, so consider the target’s position in teamfights.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next basic attack and silences, so don’t engage first while it’s active. The longer you stay close while Garen E Judgment is spinning, the more damage you take, so leave its range. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after activation, so delay Urgot E Disdain and R Fear Beyond Death by half a beat. If health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on missing health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main physical damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Consider tenacity if you’re concerned about being stunned against a wall by Mega Gnar R GNAR!
Gnar.combo: Once Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you circle Gnar to trigger your legs. After landing Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him.
Gnar.escape: Right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. If you need to watch out for Mega Gnar R GNAR!, avoid engaging with a wall at your back and look for an opening right after Mega Gnar returns to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.fight: Right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. With Urgot W Purge active, weave in basic attacks and circle Gnar to hit with legs that haven’t fired yet. Right after he transforms into Mega Gnar, create distance and wait it out, then start another fight as soon as he returns to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to slow for the engage instead of using it to poke. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don’t push it by accident.
Gnar.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so consolidate your gains through lane pressure and turrets in the mid game.
Gnar.teamfight: Right after Gnar returns from Mega Gnar to Mini Gnar, use the window when he can’t transform again to start a teamfight with your allies. Avoid angles for Gnar R GNAR! stuns in narrow terrain near walls. If you can pull out a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before looking for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no angle to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline.
Gnar.watch: Mini Gnar Q Boomerang Throw can hit you on its return, so step out of its path and move to keep Gnar from catching it. When Mega Gnar gets close, avoid fighting head-on and watch his rage bar. Mega Gnar R GNAR! stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so avoid positions with a wall at your back.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen’s main damage, and get armor too to account for her basic attack damage. Gwen’s high armor can block much of Urgot’s physical damage, so include penetration in your build. If the healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after your first core item.
Gwen.combo: After Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun and flip her behind you with Urgot E Disdain. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you circle Gwen to trigger Urgot P Echoing Flames. If you land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, keep damaging her until she’s below the execute threshold, then recast to finish her.
Gwen.escape: Right after you bait out Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. Around lots of minions, Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can come back quickly, so draw her away from the wave or find an angle to land Urgot E Disdain’s stun before engaging. If you also land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death at that point, its slow can make it harder for her to escape.
Gwen.fight: Before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks, trade with Urgot W Purge active and weave in basic attacks. When fighting close, circle Gwen to hit her with other legs that have Urgot P Echoing Flames. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then engage with Urgot E Disdain.
Gwen.laning: Early on, stay outside Gwen’s basic attack range to limit chances for Gwen P A Thousand Cuts to heal, and trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to start an engage with Urgot E Disdain. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don’t push it by accident.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, your short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so consolidate your gains through lane pressure and turrets in the mid game.
Gwen.teamfight: Look for an angle to pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, then damage them with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before following up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. The execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death fears nearby enemies in front of Urgot, so consider the target’s position before choosing them. If there’s no angle to pull someone out, don’t force an engage; attack the frontline and look for a chance to finish someone off.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone deals true damage, so walk to the side to avoid the center. Gwen inside Gwen W Hallowed Mist can’t be targeted from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash can be used again sooner if it hits a minion, so don’t overpursue her in the wave.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after your first core item. Keep dealing damage with Urgot W Purge to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Illaoi.combo: Once Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun her. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks to hit with your legs. After landing Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower her health below the execute threshold and recast to finish her.
Illaoi.escape: Right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If you dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, you can close the gap without risking having your spirit pulled out. If you’re ganked, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to escape.
Illaoi.fight: Close the gap and fight right after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Illaoi to hit with legs that haven’t fired yet. Don’t fight for long near tentacles while Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so it doesn’t automatically attack minions. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge for the engage instead of using it to poke.
Illaoi.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so turn lane and turret advantages into a lead in the mid game.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t fight near Illaoi’s tentacles; destroy them or draw her away from walls. Against Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out instead of grouping to weather its brief damage window. If you can pull out a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before following up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death and fear on nearby enemies.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out a spirit and leaves a slow and mark, so stay out of range and dodge it, even when last-hitting. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, don’t fight near tentacles; spread out and wait out its duration. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on health alone to absorb it.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against Irelia’s main damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and W Defiant Dance. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge can turn a duel around, buy Executioner’s Calling after your first core item. Keep dealing damage with Urgot W Purge to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun her. Follow with Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks. To finish her off, land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, deal more damage to lower her below the execute threshold, then recast to reel her in and execute.
Irelia.escape: Right after you make Irelia use Q Bladesurge is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, there’s less risk of being interrupted as you engage. If you’re ganked, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to escape.
Irelia.fight: After Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. In close combat, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Irelia to trigger Urgot P Echoing Flames from multiple directions.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and take a step back when she can reach you with Irelia Q Bladesurge. When pulling the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge, which also hits minions, and last-hit only. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge for the engage instead of using it to poke.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, your short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so consolidate your advantage through lane pressure and turrets in the mid game.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and E Flawless Duet have a major impact in teamfights, so focus Irelia first. If you can pull her out with Urgot E Disdain, damage her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before following up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no angle to pull her out, don’t force an engage; attack the frontline and look for an execute opportunity.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain across low-health minions to close in and heal, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge’s perimeter, wait for the blades to disappear.

Jax.build: Consider items that reduce the damage from Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed first. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jax.combo: Once Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. After landing Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to lower his health. Once he’s below the execute threshold, recast Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to finish him.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Q Leap Strike is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. Once you confirm Jax E Counter Strike is also down, engage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge’s slow followed by Urgot E Disdain’s stun. While Jax E Counter Strike is active, save Urgot E Disdain for survival and move out of the stun’s range.
Jax.fight: Before Jax E Counter Strike is down, stop basic attacks and Urgot W Purge fire, and briefly create distance. After Jax Q Leap Strike and E Counter Strike are down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. Then activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Jax to trigger your legs.
Jax.laning: When pulling the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don’t push it by accident.
Jax.phase: After that, as Urgot W Purge gains levels, your trades get stronger, so build a lane advantage when Jax’s Counter Strike is down. In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes teamfight engages difficult.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax leaps in with Q Leap Strike while E Counter Strike is active, spread out so you aren’t hit by the area stun together. Once Counter Strike ends, stun him with Urgot E Disdain and deal damage with Urgot W Purge. If you can execute a target in the enemy group with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, you can fear nearby enemies.
Jax.watch: Jax Q Leap Strike can use minions as a springboard, so don’t stand near a group of minions. Don’t use Urgot E Disdain first when Jax only activates E Counter Strike and pretends to engage.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the main damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: Once Jayce’s hammer Q To the Skies! is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and attack with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks. If you land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold with Q, W, and basic attacks, then recast R.
Jayce.escape: Right after you make Jayce use hammer Q To the Skies! is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. If Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate’s knockback is also down, it’s a good time to fight close; after engaging, use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death’s slow to prevent his escape.
Jayce.fight: After Jayce’s hammer Q To the Skies! is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you circle Jayce so your legs that haven’t fired yet point toward him.
Jayce.laning: While Jayce is strong early, farm defensively by moving side to side along the line of cannon Q. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge for the engage. When pulling the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn’t automatically hit minions.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so if you fall behind, don’t force a comeback; farm and hold on. In the late game, your short range makes engaging difficult, so consolidate your advantage through lane pressure and turrets in the mid game.
Jayce.teamfight: If Jayce’s hammer Q To the Skies! is down, look for an angle to pull him out with Urgot E Disdain. If you pull him in, lower his health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge before following up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no angle to pull him out, don’t force it; attack the frontline and look for a position where R’s execute can fear nearby enemies.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce has his cannon, watch out for ranged poke. If you see Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, move to the side to dodge the following Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. When he has his hammer, watch out for Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate.

Kennen.build: Build magic resistance over armor against the damage from Kennen Q, W, and E.
Kennen.combo: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you move so your leg cannons hit Kennen. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to drop him below the execute threshold, then recast to finish him.
Kennen.escape: The moment Kennen E Lightning Rush goes down is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If you have two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm, back away first and wait for the stacks to disappear before engaging.
Kennen.fight: Don't use Urgot E Disdain first while Kennen E Lightning Rush is available. If Kennen engages with E or has just used it, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with E to stun him. Once you're on him, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you move around Kennen to trigger your leg cannons.
Kennen.laning: Block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken from behind minions, and only step forward briefly to last-hit. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don't push the wave unintentionally.
Kennen.phase: In the late game, your short range makes engaging difficult, so don’t force an engage onto Kennen.
Kennen.teamfight: Spread out with your allies so you don't all get caught by Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom's AoE stun, and use vision to block Kennen's entry path. When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and you have an angle to pull a target with Urgot E Disdain, follow up with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge. If there's no angle to pull someone out, attack the frontline and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Kennen.watch: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken only hits the first target, so dodge it from behind minions. If two stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm have built up, back away to avoid the third stack and stun. Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom applies stacks in an area and also increases Kennen's resistances, so spread out with your allies when an engage opportunity becomes apparent.

KSante.build: Consider armor penetration first so K'Sante's high armor doesn't blunt your damage. Build armor against the physical damage from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and K'Sante W Path Maker, and get enough health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. Magic resistance won't help against the K'Sante damage covered here.
KSante.combo: Once K'Sante's mobility abilities have been used and he has expended his charge of K'Sante W Path Maker, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. Land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, then keep firing with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks to trigger your leg cannons. When his health falls below the execute threshold, recast Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to pull him in and execute.
KSante.escape: If you engage just because K'Sante W Path Maker is down, he can escape with K'Sante E Footwork or K'Sante R All Out. Land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death then to stop his escape.
KSante.fight: Don't use your damage while K'Sante W Path Maker is charging; dodge the charge, then fight. When K'Sante W Path Maker, K'Sante E Footwork, and K'Sante R All Out are down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and land Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on him, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you circle K'Sante, aiming your leg cannons that can still trigger at him.
KSante.laning: Urgot Q Corrosive Charge also deals little damage at this point, so don't push too deep. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to engage. To pull the wave toward you, last-hit only with Urgot W Purge off, since it also hits minions.
KSante.phase: As K'Sante accumulates defensive items, laning becomes difficult, and in the late game Urgot's short range also makes it hard for him to engage in teamfights.
KSante.teamfight: When K'Sante activates K'Sante R All Out, his armor drops significantly, so focus him with your team, but don't face his increased damage and lifesteal alone. Have at least one person on your team bring Grievous Wounds, and don't let K'Sante keep hitting multiple people. If there's no angle to pull a backline target with Urgot E Disdain, attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and look to execute a target in the enemy group with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death for an AoE fear.
KSante.watch: If K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes hits you repeatedly, back out of range to avoid the next pull and stun, and watch the stacks he builds on minions. When you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, save Urgot E Disdain until its unstoppable effect and damage reduction end, and dodge to the side of its charge direction. Don't keep terrain behind you, so K'Sante R All Out can't knock you through a wall.

Mordekaiser.build: After finishing your first core item, fit in Executioner's Calling if the healing from Mordekaiser W Indestructible can turn a duel around. Build magic resistance first against Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, and Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and get armor too for his basic attacks. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Mordekaiser.combo: When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and follow up with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to the slowed target to drop him below the execute threshold, then recast to pull him in. Right after Mordekaiser W Indestructible creates a shield, focus him once the shield has worn down or turned into healing instead of pouring in your damage immediately.
Mordekaiser.escape: After Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses is your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. Mordekaiser has no skill to create distance on his own, so if you catch him when there's no risk of being isolated, keep up the pressure with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Mordekaiser.fight: Trade briefly and back off before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp misses and there's no risk of being isolated by Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on him, keep using Urgot W Purge and basic attacks as you circle him, hitting him with leg cannons that haven't triggered yet.
Mordekaiser.laning: Urgot W Purge becomes stronger for trades as you level it, but watch how long you stay close, since that can activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you don't push the wave unintentionally.
Mordekaiser.phase: In the late game, your short range makes it hard to engage in teamfights, so don't force yourself to engage first.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Spread out with your allies so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn't pull several of you in, and avoid positions where Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate you alone. If there's an angle to pull someone out, use Urgot E Disdain to flip the target toward your allies and deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge. If there's no angle, attack the frontline and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, watching the execute target's position so you can fear nearby enemies.
Mordekaiser.watch: If Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp pulls you in, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise can follow, so keep your distance and dodge from the front. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so end the trade before then, and don't stay close once it's active. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is ready, don't enter its range alone and risk a duel where your allies can't help.

Nasus.build: Buy armor items first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Armor won't stop the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so don't rely on armor alone to endure their area or ultimate.
Nasus.combo: Slow Nasus with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and flip him behind you. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you circle Nasus, using leg cannons that haven't triggered yet. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold with Q, W, and basic attacks, then recast to execute.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, it's your chance to engage with Urgot E Disdain. Nasus has no way to create distance on his own besides Flash, so after catching him with E, use the slow from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to stop his escape. If Nasus W Wither forces you to back off, turn off Urgot W Purge and use Urgot E Disdain's shield and movement.
Nasus.fight: Pressure Nasus early when he comes to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain and activate Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks as you circle Nasus to trigger your leg cannons. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't force the fight to continue.
Nasus.laning: If you push the wave all the way to Nasus's turret, it becomes easier for him to last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Urgot W Purge can hit minions and push the wave, so turn it off and last-hit only when you want to pull the wave toward you. Let the wave come toward your side, then pressure Nasus when he approaches to stack, or call for a jungle gank.
Nasus.teamfight: If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don't face him head-on; keep your distance and wait out its duration. If Urgot E Disdain can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there's no angle to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute opportunity. If the execute target is near the enemy group, also look for an AoE fear.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither lowers your movement and attack speed, so don't stay in a long fight while affected. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor, so leave its area. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting and wait out its duration unless you clearly have the numbers and damage advantage.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. Resistances don't work against the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so get health too, and consider an attack speed slow.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then engage with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow up with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks to trigger your leg cannons. After landing Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him.
Olaf.escape: Look for an engage when blocking Olaf Q Undertow's axe retrieval cuts off his path to approach. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait for it to end, then engage with Urgot E Disdain. Olaf has no skill to create distance on his own, so after catching him you can look for a chance to finish with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Olaf.fight: When fighting, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks as you circle Olaf, dealing steady damage with leg cannons that haven't triggered yet. Olaf gains attack speed and lifesteal as his health gets lower, so don't chase just because he's at half health.
Olaf.laning: Avoid the side where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands to stop him retrieving it, and focus on avoiding an early death. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave doesn't push on its own. When looking for a kill, don't use Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to poke; save it to engage.
Olaf.phase: Olaf becomes relatively weaker later, but Urgot's short range means you still need to choose your teamfight engage carefully.
Olaf.teamfight: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't engage first expecting the stun from Urgot E Disdain or the crowd control from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to stop him. When an opening appears, use Urgot E Disdain to pull a target out, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there's no angle to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and look for a position where the execute can fear nearby enemies.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows you, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to stop him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, which armor can't reduce, so respond with Urgot E Disdain's shield and distance when your health is low. While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance instead of trying to withstand it with the stun from Urgot E Disdain or the crowd control from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.

Ornn.build: The provided information doesn't identify a specific starting item. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid building resistance against only one type. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: After Ornn's mobility is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks. To throw Ornn toward your allies, start Urgot E Disdain with your allies behind you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower Ornn's health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast to execute him.
Ornn.escape: Don't engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. Wait for an opening before Ornn R Call of the Forge God is back, then close the gap with Urgot E Disdain and hit Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If you're ganked, use Urgot E Disdain's shield and stun to escape.
Ornn.fight: Don't use Urgot E Disdain to engage while Ornn can still escape using Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God. When you go in, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Ornn gradually to hit with leg cannons that haven't fired yet. Urgot W Purge reduces your movement speed, so turn it off when ending a chase or backing away.
Ornn.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up an Urgot E Disdain engage. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge, which also attacks minions, and last-hit only. Move in and attack when Ornn tries to forge an item.
Ornn.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it hard to engage teamfights, while Ornn's items and his allies' masterwork upgrades accumulate. Use your midgame advantage to apply pressure quickly.
Ornn.teamfight: Position yourself away from the path of the ram summoned by Ornn R Call of the Forge God and the straight line where Ornn will headbutt it back. If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute.
Ornn.watch: Near the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or walls, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up, so move toward open ground. If Ornn W Bellows Breath's final flame makes you Brittle, don't move forward; keep your distance until the effect expires. Dodge Ornn R Call of the Forge God's ram to the side when it first approaches, and stay out of the path where Ornn will headbutt it back.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon's main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so add penetration to Urgot's physical damage.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon's mobility is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun him with Urgot E Disdain and flip him behind you. Activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Pantheon to trigger your leg cannons. After Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him.
Pantheon.escape: Don't use Urgot E Disdain to engage while Pantheon W Shield Vault is available. The chance to engage comes after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is back. Close the gap with Urgot E Disdain then, and use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to prevent his escape.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on him, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Pantheon to trigger your leg cannons.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and don't give up a kill. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up an Urgot E Disdain engage. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn't automatically hit minions.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off late, but Urgot's short range also makes it hard to engage teamfights, so consolidate your tower gains in the midgame.
Pantheon.teamfight: While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, move around to the side or wait for it to end. If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If there's no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute when multiple enemies can be hit by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death's fear.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so it's hard to dodge once you're in range. Reduce the poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear by keeping minions between you. Stop attacking from the front or move around to the side during Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy's main damage from Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. Don't spend resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun her with Urgot E Disdain and flip her behind you. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks, circling Poppy to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower her health below the execute threshold with Q, W, and basic attacks, then recast to finish her.
Poppy.escape: Right after you make Poppy use E Heroic Charge is your chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain. However, if Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don't dash in; wait for its duration to end. If it's hard to use Urgot E Disdain to engage, save it as an escape tool for its shield and stun.
Poppy.fight: Look for an opening right after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge: slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and close in with Urgot E Disdain. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to use Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on her, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Poppy gradually to hit with leg cannons that haven't fired yet.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open ground without a wall behind you to avoid being stunned into a wall by Poppy E Heroic Charge. When the shield Poppy throws with Poppy P Iron Ambassador lands, step on it first to deny her shield. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn't automatically attack minions, and last-hit only.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it hard to engage teamfights, so secure your advantage with midgame lane pressure and towers.
Poppy.teamfight: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, engage if you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain. Build up damage on the target you pull with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If there's no angle to pull someone, don't force it; attack the frontline and look for an AoE fear when enemies are grouped around the target you execute.
Poppy.watch: Urgot E Disdain is blocked while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, so wait for it to end or walk up to her. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don't let a wall sit behind you. If you're hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, leave the remaining zone immediately. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways from in front of her.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against Renekton's main damage from Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice. However, the recast of empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so position to dodge that dash rather than simply stacking more armor. If healing from Renekton Q Cull the Meek could turn a duel around, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after your first core item.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and throw him behind you. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks, circling him to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold with Q, W, and basic attacks, then recast R to finish him.
Renekton.escape: The window to engage with Urgot E Disdain is after Renekton has spent Renekton E Slice and Dice disengaging, or immediately after he has used all of Q, W, and E. Engage especially when his Fury is empty, and keep your distance while the stun from empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator is available. If you're ganked, use Urgot E Disdain's shield and stun to escape.
Renekton.fight: Force trades when Renekton P Reign of Anger is empty. Right after Renekton uses Q, W, and E, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to maintain fire, moving gradually around him to line up leg cannons that haven't fired yet.
Renekton.laning: Adjust your position, since standing among or behind a group of minions can give Renekton E Slice and Dice a springboard to engage. Poke Renekton when he walks forward to hit minions and build Fury, but when looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up an engage. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave doesn't push unintentionally.
Renekton.phase: Let the duration of Renekton R Dominus run out, and grow without giving up a kill. Secure your advantage with midgame lane pressure and towers.
Renekton.teamfight: If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, follow up with Q and W damage and look for an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. Watch the position of your R target so the fear on execution hits multiple enemies. If there's no angle to pull someone, don't force it; attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and wait for an R execute opportunity.
Renekton.watch: If Renekton P Reign of Anger is over half full or just below half, respect empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of range. Empowered W breaks Urgot E Disdain's shield first, so don't rely on the shield to absorb the combo.

Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, prioritize defensive items earlier and get enough health to survive her finishing damage.
Riven.combo: When Riven's mobility is down, slow her with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun her with Urgot E Disdain and flip her behind you. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower her health below the execute threshold, then recast to finish her.
Riven.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack when Riven Q Broken Wings is used on minions or right after Riven gets on you. Catch her engage with Urgot E Disdain to gain its stun and shield, then activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Riven to trigger your leg cannons.
Riven.laning: Counterattack when Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions. When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up Urgot E Disdain. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only.
Riven.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it hard to engage teamfights.
Riven.teamfight: If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If there's no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute. Executing a target in a group with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death can fear nearby enemies.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings dashes three times and knocks you up on the last cast, while Riven W Ki Burst stuns you. Be especially careful of the finishing damage from Riven R Blade of the Exile when health has been reduced.

Rumble.build: If you need a defensive item, prioritize one with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: After the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends, slow Rumble with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks, circling Rumble to trigger your leg cannons. After Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so look for a chance to catch him with Urgot E Disdain when the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield ends. If you're hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, decide whether to use Urgot E Disdain to create distance before the second harpoon arrives.
Rumble.fight: Instead of staying close while taking damage from Rumble Q Flamespitter, look for an opening when the shield and movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield end. If you manage to engage, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Rumble to continue dealing damage with leg cannons that haven't fired yet.
Rumble.laning: When looking for a kill, don't use Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to poke; save it as a slow to set up Urgot E Disdain. To pull the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave doesn't push unintentionally.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it hard to engage teamfights, so secure your advantage with midgame lane pressure and towers.
Rumble.teamfight: If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, follow up with damage from Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If the enemy is grouped and there's no angle to pull someone, attack the frontline and wait. When executing, consider the position that will let the fear reach nearby enemies.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on your maximum health while you're close to him, so keep enough distance that Rumble has to walk forward to reach you. If you're hit by the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance or use Urgot E Disdain to get away before the second harpoon's stronger slow and magic resistance reduction hit you.

Sett.build: Build armor first against the damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Since basic attacks make up a large portion of his damage, reducing his attack speed is also effective. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, and resistances can't reduce the true damage in the center of Sett W Haymaker, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: During the window after Sett R The Show Stopper is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and throw him behind you. Follow up by activating Urgot W Purge and weaving in basic attacks, circling Sett to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to get him below the execute threshold, then recast to pull him in and execute him.
Sett.escape: Before engaging, avoid a position that lines you up with enemies on both sides of Sett so you can dodge the stun from Sett E Facebreaker. If you're ganked, use Urgot E Disdain's shield and stun to escape, and turn off Urgot W Purge while fleeing.
Sett.fight: When Sett walks in, create distance first. After Sett R The Show Stopper is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and look to engage with Urgot E Disdain. Once you're on him, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks, circling Sett to line up any leg cannons that can still fire. Back away briefly right after dealing a lot of damage to respect Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: Keep your range and poke Sett, but back away first when he starts walking in. When looking for a kill, don't use Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to poke; save it to set up Urgot E Disdain. To pull the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only to avoid pushing unintentionally.
Sett.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it hard to engage teamfights, so avoid forcing an engage.
Sett.teamfight: If Urgot E Disdain can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an Urgot R Fear Beyond Death execute. If the enemy is grouped and there's no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and look for a finishing opportunity. Watch your target's position so the fear from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death's execute hits multiple enemies.
