Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker becomes dangerous right after Sett has taken a lot of damage, so back away briefly after dealing damage and dodge the center of its aiming line to the side. Sett E Facebreaker stuns only if there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so don't get caught between a minion wave and Sett. Be careful while Sett R The Show Stopper is available, since he can grab and suppress you.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to counter the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so build both resistances. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid building heavily into health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun and throw him behind you with Urgot E Disdain. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks and circling Shen to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to bring him below the execute threshold, then recast to reel him in.
Shen.escape: When Shen E Shadow Dash misses and his taunt and mobility are down, engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Shen R Stand United is available, do not go deep just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Look for an opening before Shen R Stand United comes back, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain, and finish with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Shen.fight: Engage with Urgot E Disdain immediately after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Shen so your unused leg cannons face him. Stop basic attacking while Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, then re-engage when it ends.
Shen.laning: Use Urgot W Purge to pressure Shen and take lane control, making Shen take CS. To pull the wave toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only, so its automatic attacks do not push the lane. If Shen leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, gain an advantage on that side.
Shen.phase: In the mid game, secure your advantage with lane pressure and towers. In the late game, your short range makes engaging difficult, so look for openings carefully.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join fights with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team when he disappears or starts channeling. If you can pull a target from behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and choose an execute target whose position will let the fear hit nearby enemies.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you will be hit by basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of the spirit blade returning with Shen Q Twilight Assault. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, your basic attacks are blocked, so resume attacking after it ends.

Singed.build: Build magic resistance first to counter the damage from Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling. Also get movement speed to leave poisoned areas, and avoid relying on health alone against Singed E Fling, which deals damage based on your max health.
Singed.combo: Away from Singed W Mega Adhesive, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then engage with Urgot E Disdain to stun and throw him behind you. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and hit with your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, bring his health below the execute threshold, then recast to finish him.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage with Urgot E Disdain while Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are down. If adhesive is underfoot, move out of it first because you cannot dash there.
Singed.fight: When Singed is close, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle him to hit with your unused leg cannons. If Singed runs, do not chase him far through his poison; fight within range to catch him with the slow from Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot E Disdain.
Singed.laning: When looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up Urgot E Disdain. To pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave does not push unintentionally.
Singed.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes engaging difficult, and Singed becomes hard to kill once he has his core items.
Singed.teamfight: Do not chase a charging Singed to the end. While he is held by Urgot E Disdain or Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, attack his allies. If you can pull an enemy from behind the frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, hit the frontline and look for an execute that can fear nearby enemies based on the target's position.
Singed.watch: Following Singed Q Poison Trail means taking repeated poison damage, so do not chase unless you can still deal enough damage to execute him. You cannot dash with Urgot E Disdain while on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and Singed E Fling can root you there. Go around the adhesive, and stay out of Singed E Fling's range when he has his back to an ally.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer first, since it reduces your armor when it hits. Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your max health, so be cautious about building heavily into health alone.
Sion.combo: After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash or once Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, slow Sion with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then engage with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks and circling him to trigger your leg cannons. After hitting with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him.
Sion.escape: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side before engaging. If he is charging it, pressure him up close to make him use it early. If you are ganked, use the shield and stun from Urgot E Disdain to escape, and turn off Urgot W Purge as you retreat.
Sion.fight: After dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to keep firing. Circling Sion gradually lets you use your unused leg cannons more effectively. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus damage on the shield immediately and break it before it explodes.
Sion.laning: Then pressure with Urgot W Purge, but turn it off and last-hit only when you want to pull the lane toward you, avoiding an unwanted push. If Sion keeps getting CS, his max health increases, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane during that time.
Sion.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes it difficult to engage in teamfights, while Sion's max health increases as he farms CS.
Sion.teamfight: If you can pull one target from behind Sion's frontline with Urgot E Disdain, focus them with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, do not force an engage; keep attacking the frontline with W and look for an R finish. The R execute fears nearby enemies in front of Urgot, so target someone where several enemies are grouped.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, circle to the side to dodge it. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you, so avoid getting hit. Do not meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep it. After Sion revives with Sion P Glory in Death, do not keep fighting in place; reposition to regain distance.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first against Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. If you need to remove Skarner R Impale, decide in advance whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then stun and flip him with Urgot E Disdain. Follow with W Purge, weaving in basic attacks and circling Skarner to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, bring Skarner below the execute threshold with Q, W, and basic attacks, then recast R.
Skarner.escape: Look to engage right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Close the gap with Urgot E Disdain then and land Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to make it difficult for Skarner to escape. Skarner R Impale cannot be cleansed with Urgot E Disdain, so do not save E expecting to escape after being suppressed.
Skarner.fight: Close the distance and fight right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, follow with Urgot E Disdain, then activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks. Circle Skarner gradually to hit with your unused leg cannons.
Skarner.laning: When looking for a kill, save Q to set up E Disdain. To pull the lane toward you, turn off W and last-hit only so you do not push the wave unintentionally.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, your short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so focus on building a mid-game lead before Skarner gets tank items.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance from walls and Skarner's team to avoid angles for Skarner E Ixtal's Impact and R Impale. If you have an angle to pull a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge, then follow with an execute from R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, do not force an engage; attack the frontline and look for an R finish that can fear nearby enemies.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against Tahm Kench's main damage. Tahm Kench has high armor, so consider penetration for Urgot's physical damage.
TahmKench.combo: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and attack with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks. To look for an execute, hit with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to slow him, bring his health below the execute threshold, then recast to reel him in.
TahmKench.escape: The opening to engage with Urgot E Disdain is after Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks, do not engage; back off and wait for them to disappear. If you are ganked, use the shield and stun from Urgot E Disdain to escape.
TahmKench.fight: Engage when there are no stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down. Avoid short trades because Tahm Kench E Thick Skin gives him a shield and healing; instead, activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to focus your damage. Circle Tahm Kench gradually to hit with the unused leg cannons from Urgot P Echoing Flames.
TahmKench.laning: To pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave does not push unintentionally.
TahmKench.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so avoid forcing them.
TahmKench.teamfight: When Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is visible, spread out from your allies so you are not all hit by its area knock-up. If Tahm Kench R Devour is available, account for the possibility that he can swallow the ally he is protecting; if he does, focus Tahm Kench. If you have an angle to pull an enemy from behind the frontline with Urgot E Disdain, attack with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge and look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle, keep attacking the frontline.
TahmKench.watch: If you have two stacks of Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, back off and wait for them to disappear. They can lead into the slow and stun from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench R Devour. When you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive's dive animation, do not bunch up at the landing point.

Teemo.build: Teemo's main damage from Q Blinding Dart, E Toxic Shot, and R Noxious Trap is magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Prepare Oracle Lens to clear traps from key pathways.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks and staying close as you fire. Hit with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to slow him, bring his health below the execute threshold, then recast to execute.
Teemo.escape: Engage when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. If Teemo W Move Quick is down too, use Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to slow him and look for a chance to close the gap with Urgot E Disdain.
Teemo.fight: Look to trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to close in, then activate Urgot W Purge and weave in basic attacks to keep firing. Circle him gradually so your unused leg cannons face him.
Teemo.laning: In the early game, avoid short trades where you take Teemo's ranged basic attacks and back off. To pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave does not push unintentionally. If you plan to engage, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to set up a slow instead of using it to poke.
Teemo.phase: In the mid game, secure your advantage with lane pressure and towers. In the late game, avoid forcing teamfight engages because of your short range.
Teemo.teamfight: Expect Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages, and use Oracle Lens to clear key pathways. If you can pull a target with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and W Purge, then follow with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, attack the frontline and look for an R execute on a target positioned so the fear can reach several enemies.
Teemo.watch: If Teemo Q Blinding Dart hits you, your basic attacks are blocked, so wait until the blind wears off before trading with basic attacks. Teemo E Toxic Shot keeps dealing poison damage after even one basic attack, so stay out of range unless you are ready to engage. Watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare stealth and Teemo R Noxious Trap in bushes without vision and key pathways.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle's basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. Trundle R Subjugate reduces your resistances and deals damage based on max health, so do not rely on heavily stacking resistance or health alone. If Trundle's healing is enough to turn the duel, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after your first core item.
Trundle.combo: Slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and throw him behind you. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle in the direction where your leg cannons are still available. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, bring his health below the execute threshold, then recast to finish him.
Trundle.escape: Avoid the slow and blocked escape route from Trundle E Pillar of Ice, and engage with Urgot E Disdain after Trundle W Frozen Domain and Trundle Q Chomp's attack damage reduction have ended. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you catch him, use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to prevent his escape.
Trundle.fight: Fight after Trundle Q Chomp's attack damage reduction and Trundle W Frozen Domain have ended. Slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and hit with Urgot E Disdain, then activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Trundle to trigger your leg cannons. If Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance.
Trundle.laning: Trundle heals through Trundle P King's Tribute whenever a minion dies, so do not spend too long merely poking and prolonging the lane. If you lower his health, take an advantage immediately or push to force him to recall. To pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only.
Trundle.teamfight: Do not leave a frontline ally hit by Trundle R Subjugate alone to fight him. If you can pull a target from behind the frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there is no angle to pull someone, keep attacking the frontline and look for an execute target whose position lets the fear hit nearby enemies.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so back off until the effect ends. Do not fight him head-on while Trundle W Frozen Domain or Trundle R Subjugate is active. Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape in narrow paths, so fight in open areas and immediately move to the side when a pillar appears.

Tryndamere.build: Build armor first against Tryndamere's physical damage and critical strikes. Since he relies heavily on basic attacks, Thornmail is effective. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust is enough to turn the duel, fit Executioner's Calling into your build after your first core item.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him and follow with Urgot W Purge and basic attacks. After hitting with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, lower his health below the execute threshold and recast to finish him. Tryndamere cannot die while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, so wait until it ends before looking to execute.
Tryndamere.escape: The window to engage is right after making Tryndamere use E Spinning Slash. Close the gap with Urgot E Disdain then, land the stun, and use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to prevent his escape. If you need to retreat, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, and turn off Urgot W Purge.
Tryndamere.fight: Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then close in with Urgot E Disdain and stun him. Keep Urgot W Purge active, weave in basic attacks, and circle him gradually to trigger your leg cannons. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, do not rush the execute; wait it out.
Tryndamere.laning: In the early game, harass Tryndamere to make it difficult for him to last-hit, limiting his Fury and the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust. To pull the lane toward you, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so you do not push the wave unintentionally.
Tryndamere.phase: In the late game, Urgot's short range makes teamfight engages difficult, so avoid forcing them.
Tryndamere.teamfight: If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready, do not try to stop him alone in a side lane; trade for an objective or send more players. In teamfights, look for an angle to pull a target with Urgot E Disdain. If there is no angle, attack the frontline with Urgot W Purge and wait for a finishing opportunity with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Pulling an execute target in from the enemy group can also fear nearby enemies.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury makes his critical strikes stronger, so create distance when he starts building Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and in a large minion wave critical strikes reduce its cooldown, making it difficult to chase him. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot die, so use Urgot E Disdain to buy time or create distance instead of dumping damage into him.

Udyr.build: Build armor first to defend against Udyr’s main damage. Also account for the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm and the mixed damage from Udyr Q Wilding Claw, so don’t stack health alone. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle can turn a duel, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing your first core item.
Udyr.combo: When Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weaving in basic attacks to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to bring him below the execute threshold, then recast to pull him in.
Udyr.escape: The moment after you make Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your window to engage with Urgot E Disdain. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, immobilizing effects won’t work, so wait until it ends to stun him, then use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to prevent his escape.
Udyr.fight: Chip away at Udyr before he approaches, but save Urgot E Disdain for when he gets on top of you. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle him to trigger your leg cannons.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, don’t push forward; track his path with vision at key routes and jungle entrances. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only. If you’re looking for a kill, save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to help you engage.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, your short range makes it difficult to enter teamfights.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to force down Udyr when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. If you can pull out a target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then look for an execute with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline and watch for an execute opportunity.
Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr E Blazing Stampede activates, watch for the stun on his first attack. While Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, don’t try to apply crowd control that prevents movement. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance before he gets on top of you.

Volibear.build: Build armor first to defend against the main damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul can turn a duel, buy Executioner’s Calling after completing your first core item. You can keep Grievous Wounds applied by dealing damage with Urgot W Purge.
Volibear.combo: After Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle him to hit with your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast to finish him.
Volibear.escape: Look to engage during a window when both Volibear Q Thundering Smash and Volibear R Stormbringer are down. If only one is down, he can escape with the other movement ability, so don’t use Urgot E Disdain first. When Volibear Q Thundering Smash is chasing you, stay outside basic attack range instead of running in a straight line; if needed, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to get away.
Volibear.fight: Fight after Volibear P The Relentless Storm stacks fall off and Volibear Q Thundering Smash ends. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Volibear in small steps to hit with leg cannons that haven’t fired yet. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul can heal him substantially, don’t prolong the fight without a clear chance to finish him.
Volibear.laning: Poke Volibear from range while Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, but save Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to help you engage if you’re looking for a kill. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn’t automatically hit minions.
Volibear.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it hard to enter teamfights, so attack the frontline and look for an execute instead of forcing an engage.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear is stacking Volibear P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions or monsters, don’t take the fight; wait until the stacks fall off. If you can pull out a target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, attack the frontline. When executing, look for a position where nearby enemies will also be feared.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash boosts his movement speed so he can approach and stun you; stay outside basic attack range until it expires. When you see the marker from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid the damage and slow. When health is low, watch out for healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, retreat well back even under your turret.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first. Yasuo’s main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath is physical. Armor does not affect the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so don’t expect it to block that damage.
Yasuo.combo: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, then slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Yasuo to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, deal more damage to bring him below the execute threshold, then recast to pull him in and execute him.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an opening right after Yasuo casts his tornado, when Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s stacks reset. Don’t engage as soon as Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; look for a chance to catch him with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. At that point, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain and use Urgot R Fear Beyond Death to prevent his escape.
Yasuo.fight: Break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke before committing to a trade. Hit him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge so Urgot W Purge targets him first, then weave in basic attacks and circle him in small steps to fire leg cannons that haven’t triggered yet. When Yasuo can escape with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, don’t use Urgot E Disdain first to engage.
Yasuo.laning: Yasuo approaches by dashing through minions with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, so keep the wave thin on your side to limit his footholds. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only so the wave doesn’t push unintentionally. If you’re looking for a kill, don’t use Urgot Q Corrosive Charge to poke; save its slow to help you engage.
Yasuo.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it hard to enter teamfights, so consolidate your advantage with lane pressure and turrets in the mid game.
Yasuo.teamfight: If you can pull out a target from the enemy group, including Yasuo, with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. Position the target near the enemy group so nearby enemies can be feared.
Yasuo.watch: If Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, his next attack sends out a tornado that knocks enemies up. When his stacks are ready, step out of its line and dodge to the side. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him approach by dashing through minions, so don’t give him room between your minions. While Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, hold key abilities it can block and use them after the wall disappears.

Yone.build: The starting item can’t be specified because the source doesn’t provide one. Yone’s damage is a mix of physical and magic, so don’t build resistance to only one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Consider attack speed reduction and movement speed to get out of its telegraphed area.
Yone.combo: After Yone’s movement abilities are down, slow him with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun him. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Yone to trigger your leg cannons. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits, lower his health below the execute threshold with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, Urgot W Purge, and basic attacks, then recast to finish him.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down; check whether he can escape with Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed. In particular, close the gap with Urgot E Disdain when his other mobility options are also down, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up. If Yone enters first in spirit form, you can use Urgot E Disdain’s stun to stop him from returning.
Yone.fight: When Yone’s tornado isn’t ready, activate Urgot W Purge and fight up close, weaving in basic attacks. Circle Yone in small steps to line up leg cannons that haven’t triggered yet. If Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stun him with Urgot E Disdain and prevent him from returning.
Yone.laning: Once Urgot W Purge has a level, look for trades where you stay close and keep firing. When pulling the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge so it doesn’t automatically hit minions.
Yone.phase: In the mid game, consolidate your advantage through the lane and turrets. In the late game, when your short range makes it hard to engage, avoid forcing an entry.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out so several teammates aren’t hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and position your formation with the knowledge that Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion hit. If you can pull out a target with Urgot E Disdain, lower their health with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, keep attacking the frontline. When executing, look for a position where nearby enemies can be feared.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. After Yone enters with Yone E Soul Unbound, he deals extra damage when returning, so get out of range before health drops. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path and moves Yone behind the last champion hit, so check your position just before a teamfight.

Yorick.build: Build armor first to defend against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal damage based on your maximum health and aren’t blocked by armor, so avoid stacking health alone. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites can turn a duel, fit Executioner’s Calling into your build after completing your first core item.
Yorick.combo: Slow Yorick with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, then dash in with Urgot E Disdain to stun and flip him behind you. Follow with Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Yorick to trigger your leg cannons. When you have an execute opportunity, hit him with Urgot R Fear Beyond Death first, deal more damage to bring him below the execute threshold, then recast.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no movement ability, so use Urgot E Disdain to catch him when Yorick E Mourning Mist has missed and there’s little risk of getting trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession. If you do get trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall first to break it. When in danger, use Urgot E Disdain’s shield and stun to escape.
Yorick.fight: After Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, start a trade from a position where you won’t get trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession. Activate Urgot W Purge, weave in basic attacks, and circle Yorick in small steps to deal ongoing damage with leg cannons that haven’t triggered yet. Don’t rush a fight with Yorick himself when there are many Mist Walkers or the Maiden of the Mist’s mark remains on you.
Yorick.laning: Don’t fight where Yorick has built up many graves. Push the wave to make it harder for Yorick to build up his forces on his side, but when you need to pull the wave, turn off Urgot W Purge and last-hit only. When Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, step forward to farm and pressure him.
Yorick.phase: In the late game, Urgot’s short range makes it hard to enter teamfights, so handle Yorick’s split push while also looking for objective trades elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: If you can pull out a target behind the enemy frontline with Urgot E Disdain, deal damage with Urgot Q Corrosive Charge and Urgot W Purge, then follow up with an execute from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death. If there’s no opening to pull someone out, don’t force an engage; attack the frontline and look for an execute. If enemies are gathered around a target pulled in by Urgot R Fear Beyond Death, the execute can fear them in an area.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your maximum health, so dodge its arc and move forward after it misses. If you get trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, attack the wall to break it. If the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, put distance between yourself and Yorick.
